title: MountainWest RubyConf 2013 Devs and Depression by Greg  Baugues
summary: Greg Baugues tells his story of living with bipolar II and ADHD as a developer at a Ruby conference. He urges openness about mental illness and explains how to get help and support colleagues.
why: Repeatedly recommended in mental health threads for its honest storytelling that resonates with developers.

quote.text: I recommend this talk about depression and software developers: There are newer versions of this talk, but I think this one has the most powerful storytelling.
